description: Emart parser and semantic handling policies (production-ready)

input_validity_policy.description: Guard rules to prevent accidental over-classification and role collision
rules: A line matched by emart/discount_patterns.json must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
A line matched by emart/summary_patterns.json must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
A line matched by emart/noise_patterns.json header or seller-info patterns must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
Single-line item patterns must be checked before generic item_name fallback.
Text-only lines may be item_name candidates only after detail, discount, summary, and noise checks fail.

notes: 이마트 상세라인의 상품 코드는 일반적으로 13자리 바코드
* prefix가 붙은 경우 normalization 후 code만 추출
single-line item 구조에서는 code가 없을 수 있으므로 optional field로 허용

apply_only_when: line is already classified as item_detail
code and amount fields are confidently extracted
line does not match discount_detail or receipt_discount structure

notes: qty=1 보정은 item_detail 패턴이 먼저 확정된 뒤에만 적용
텍스트 라인이나 할인 라인에는 적용하지 않음

amount_policy.description: Amount normalization and casting rules for Emart
notes: negative amount는 discount_detail일 수도 receipt_discount일 수도 있으므로 line_type 확정 전 의미를 고정하지 않음
(J), (JN), (Ph) 같은 괄호 영문 prefix는 상품명 일부가 아니라 태그성 prefix로 본다

line_classification_policy.description: Recommended order for Emart line classification
rules: single-line item_detail patterns must be checked before generic item_name rules
receipt_discount must win over discount_detail when ':' + reference code + negative amount structure exists
discount_detail must win over item_name when trailing negative amount exists
summary lines must win over generic noise
noise must be applied only as the final fallback

single_line_item_policy.description: Handling rules for item name + detail merged into one line
parser_rules: if a line matches single_line_item_patterns, classify it as item_detail
extract name_raw together with unit_price_raw, qty, and price_raw
code may be absent in this structure
do not classify lines with trailing negative amount as single-line items
notes: 퍼실 딥클린 파워젤 26,980 3 80,940 같은 구조 허용
이 경우 parser 단계에서 name_raw를 함께 추출할 수 있음

parser_rules: discount_detail lines are classified structurally only
parser must preserve discount_label_raw and discount_tag_raw when present
parser must not attach discount_detail to any item
semantic_rules: most Emart item discounts attach to the previous eligible item
use the last negative amount as the actual discount value
promotion text is auxiliary and should not override structural amount extraction

examples.semantic_expectation: attach to previous item, preserve [앱] as tag

parser_rules: lines with ':' + reference code + negative amount are receipt_discount candidates
receipt_discount must remain separate from item discount
semantic_rules: receipt_discount must not be blindly attached to the previous item
receipt-level discounts should be resolved after all lines are available

fee_policy.description: Handling rules for non-item fee lines such as bottle deposit
parser_rules: fee-like lines may be captured as store_role=fee if implemented
if common line types do not support fee, preserve as store_role and do not force-map to item_detail or noise without policy
notes: 공병 보증금은 상품도 할인도 아닌 별도 금액 항목
현재 common line_type에는 fee가 없으므로 store_role 보조 필드 활용 가능

required: strip leading star prefix when appropriate
strip item number prefix for name candidates
normalize OCR keyword variants such as 제대상금액 -> 결제대상금액
normalize spaced keywords such as 부 가 세 -> 부가세
forbidden: do not remove [앱] from raw text before semantic handoff
do not attach discount lines to items in parser stage
do not compute final_price in parser stage

requirements: all lines must be returned, including noise lines
single-line items may include both name_raw and numeric fields
final line_type must use common line type enum

receipt_level: sum(final_price) should be reconcilable with receipt total
결제대상금액 should be preferred over 합계 when both exist
notes: validation is not a parser responsibility
these are hints for semantic or downstream validation stages

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: multi_line_item_object_creation
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: item_name + item_detail 결합은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: final_price_calculation
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 최종 가격 계산은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: dropping_discount_labels_or_tags
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 프로모션명과 [앱] 태그는 후속 해석과 디버깅에 필요

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: misclassifying_discount_or_summary_as_item
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: discount, summary, item 간 충돌은 parser 단계에서 분리되어야 한다

implementation_notes: Emart 기본 상세라인 순서는 code + unit_price + qty + total_price
single-line item 구조는 일반 item_name보다 우선 검사해야 한다
discount_detail은 대부분 직전 item에 귀속되지만 parser는 구조 추출까지만 수행한다
receipt_discount와 item discount를 혼동하지 않도록 ':' + reference code 구조를 우선 처리한다
